name: S D Retail Ltd
about: Incorporated in May 2004, S D Retail Limited designs, manufactures, outsources, markets, and retails sleepwear under the brand name "SWEET DREAMS."[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] The company's product line includes stylish and comfortable sleepwear for men, women, and children.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 14.0% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 196 days.
